angleRead.name: Rachel Torres
angleRead.text: I plan to explore the implementation of the Oakland Alternative Response Initiative (OARI) in West Oakland, Fruitvale, and East Oakland. The initiative has moved into its active implementation phase, and I want to understand how it’s being received and operationalized in these communities. Specifically, I’ll focus on whether the 12 active teams in West Oakland, as mentioned by Vanessa Tran-Muñoz, are addressing the recurring issue of 'strain' noted in the data. I’ll also look into the coverage gap in the 'faith' domain, which has seen five events this cycle but zero Tribune coverage last cycle, to see if OARI is filling any gaps there.
